_about: Reviewed provider price cards and reservation policy for paid Crew Desk lanes. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens from primary provider documentation checked 2026-09-21. Estimates computed from these rates are not provider billing; reconcile against provider usage or balance changes. contextBoundTokens is a practical per-call bound: workers auto-compact at autoCompactWindowTokens and Crew Desk stops a worker if one call exceeds the bound. It is not a provider-enforced cap.

deepseek-flash.notes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Peak rates used (cache miss 0.30, cache hit 0.006, output 1.20); off-peak is half. No cache-write price is published, so cache writes are priced at the uncached input rate. The English page is USD; the account may hold CNY, so confirm currency before converting balance changes. On the Anthropic endpoint, claude-opus* model names bill as deepseek-v4-pro: every Claude Code model variable is pinned to deepseek-flash. Anthropic-endpoint usage field names are undocumented: verify on the first run.

kimi-k3.notes: Flat pricing across the 1,048,576-token window; [1m] is a Claude Code suffix stripped before sending. Cache writes are priced at the 1-hour rate (6.00; the 5-minute rate is 3.00) so estimates are upper bounds. Output includes reasoning tokens; effort max adds tokens, not a surcharge. Kimi writes cache only for top-level cache_control, so Claude Code traffic may be billed mostly as uncached input. Prices exclude tax.
